description: Splits a PDF into several files: one per range ("1-3, 4-6") or every N pages.

every.description: Pages per file, when no ranges are given (default 1)

outputDir.description: Folder for the parts (default: next to the input)

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

ranges.description: Comma-separated groups, each becomes a file, e.g. "1-3, 4, 5-"

name: pdf_split
title: Split PDF
